implementation_notes: Single leading underscore by convention, `__slots__` to prevent dynamic attribute injection, name-mangled `__attr` for stronger hiding, and `typing.Protocol` to publish the surface without a base class. Return copies (dataclasses replace) rather than internal collections.
code_sketch:
class Ledger:
    __slots__ = ('_entries',)          # no attribute injection

    def __init__(self) -> None: self._entries: list[Entry] = []

    def entries(self) -> tuple[Entry, ...]: return tuple(self._entries)   # copy-out
pitfalls: Returning the internal list so callers mutate it
`@property` that just returns the raw attribute with no invariant
